sources.title: Pityopsis
sources.clean:
Pityopsis is a genus of North American plants in the tribe Astereae within the family Asteraceae. Species of Pityopsis are known by the common names silkgrass or golden asters or grass-leaved goldenasters .

 Species
 Pityopsis aspera {{small|(Shuttlw. ex A.Gray) Small}} – Pineland silkgrass - LA MS AL GA FL SC NC VA TN 
 Pityopsis falcata {{small|(Pursh) Nutt.}} – Sickleleaf silkgrass - ONT NY MA CT RI NJ FL 
 Pityopsis flexuosa {{small|(Nash) Small}} – Zigzag silkgrass - FL 
 Pityopsis graminifolia {{small|(Michx.) Nutt.}} – Narrowleaf silkgrass - Bahamas, Belize, Honduras, Chiapas, Oaxaca, Veracruz, Tamaulipas, United States (TX LA MS AL GA FL SC NC VA MD DE WV OH KY TN AR OK) 
 Pityopsis microcephala (Small) Small - FL GA SC NC AL MS LA
 Pityopsis oligantha {{small|(Chapm. ex Torr. & A.Gray) Small}} – Grassleaf goldaster - USA (TX LA MS AL GA FL) 
 Pityopsis pinifolia {{small|(Elliott) Nutt.}} – Taylor County goldaster - USA (AL GA SC NC) 
 Pityopsis ruthii {{small|(Small) Small}} – Ruth's golden aster - TN
